paragraphs.source_en: His companion began to weep. Their sorrow touched Ieyasu deeply. Ieyasu seemed to see the withered old man tending flowers and plants in his tiny garden. Who had killed this man, nearly fifty years old? He was a retainer of Sakai Saemon-no-jō Tadatsugu. But it was he, Matsudaira Ieyasu, who had ordered Tadatsugu to take the field.
